|access-date=1 April 2023 |work= |location=}} In August 2024, former [[Chinese Communist Party Committee Secretary|CCP Committee Secretary]] of the [[Chinese Football Association]] (CFA), [[Du |archive-date=2024-08-28 |access-date=2024-08-28 |website=[[South China Morning Post]] |language=en}} On 10 September, CFA banned 38 players, including former nationals, [[Jin Jingdao]], [[Guo Tianyu]], and five officials for life over allegations of match-fixing and other forms of corruption.{{Cite web |date=2024-09-10 |title=China's Football Association bans 43 people for life after corruption investigation |url=https://apnews.com/article/china-soccer-corruption-match-fixing-e9a3812bdb2f98475aad1357d8738345 |access-date=2024-10-28 |website=AP News |language=en}} Other players and officials were also given shorter five years bans.
